name: chronal-tribute
title: Chronal Tributes
description: Four tributes that only work inside a Greater Rift: Chronal Might, Arcana, Bulwark and Fortune. Each tribute tier covers one band of rift tiers, and instead of a cost every 10 minutes they take favor once per rift run, scaled by the rift's tier. Chronal Fortune adds Chronal Shards to a clear.
